title: EFC-ΛCDM Comparative Test Specification v1.1: Pre-Registered Implementation Protocol for DES Y6 and KiDS Legacy Cosmic Shear
description: Pre-registered, content-hash–locked methodology specifying a three-stage, falsifiable comparative test of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) versus ΛCDM using Stage-III cosmic shear. It defines the phenomenological EFC extensions (µ, Σ), fixed gates and scales, priors, scan procedures, nuisance handling, scale cuts, reporting outputs, and binding stopping/falsification rules for DES Y6 and KiDS Legacy pipelines.

gate_function_g.description: Locked transition (in scale factor) gating the onset of EFC perturbations; sets when modifications become active.

k_filter_fk.description: Locked scale filter suppressing modifications at high k; controls the scale dependence of µ and Σ.

mu_param.description: Phenomenological modification to the Poisson equation entering growth; A_\mu is free with sign predicted by EFC.

sigma_param.description: Phenomenological modification to the lensing potential; A_\Sigma is free with sign predicted by EFC.

variantH_slip.description: Optional one-parameter slip relation (VariantH) reducing the model to a single amplitude degree of freedom.

S8_definition.description: Derived parameter used for comparison with weak-lensing constraints.

key_results.main_finding: This paper provides a sealed, reproducible test protocol (not results) for comparing EFC against ΛCDM on DES Y6 and KiDS Legacy cosmic shear, including fixed gates, priors, grid scans, MCMC, and binding stopping/falsification rules.
datasets_used: DES Y6 cosmic shear ξ±(θ) with fiducial scale cuts
KiDS Legacy cosmic shear (C_ell or ξ±) with fiducial scale cuts

sealed_predictions.statement: EFC predicts the preferred phenomenological quadrant A_\mu < 0 and A_\Sigma > 0 when tested on Stage-III cosmic shear with the locked gate parameters (a_t=0.7, \delta a=0.08, k_c=0.05 h/Mpc).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Full DES Y6 and KiDS Legacy likelihood analyses showing statistically significant preference for A_\mu \ge 0 and/or A_\Sigma \le 0.

sealed_predictions.statement: At A_\mu = A_\Sigma = 0 the EFC phenomenological model reduces identically to ΛCDM, matching forward-model outputs (ξ±, C_\ell^{\kappa\kappa}, f(z), \sigma_8) within ≤0.01% numerical precision.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Pixel-level equivalence check in the likelihood pipeline; any measurable deviation indicates an implementation error and invalidates the run.

sealed_predictions.statement: A background-fixed fast-scan around the ΛCDM best-fit should exhibit a measurable response in DES Y6 ξ±(θ) along the EFC-like direction if the data are sensitive to the (A_\mu, A_\Sigma) perturbations.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Fast-scan grid returning |Δχ^2_best-fit| < 1 with negligible gradient at the origin, implying sub-sensitivity at this stage (protocol stop condition).

sealed_predictions.statement: Optional VariantH slip test with Σ = 1 − (µ − 1) (α = 1 locked) provides a one-parameter EFC extension expected to prefer A_\mu < 0 if EFC-like perturbations are supported.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: 1D VariantH scan and MCMC preferring A_\mu \ge 0 or yielding no improvement relative to ΛCDM under fiducial cuts.

kill_criteria: KC1: Pixel-level equivalence failure at A_mu = A_Sigma = 0 (EFC should reduce exactly to ΛCDM within ≤0.01% for ξ±, C_ell^{κκ}, f(z), σ8). Any deviation indicates an invalid implementation; runs must be stopped and results retracted.

KC2: DES Y6 full-marginalization prefers parameter regions inconsistent with EFC sign predictions (A_mu < 0 and A_Sigma > 0), i.e., the posterior significantly favors A_mu ≥ 0 and/or A_Sigma ≤ 0 under the locked gate and priors.
KC3: KiDS Legacy full-marginalization independently favors the opposite quadrant to EFC (A_mu ≥ 0 and/or A_Sigma ≤ 0), corroborating KC2 across an independent pipeline and scale cuts.

KC4: Cross-pipeline inconsistency of EFC parameters: DES Y6 and KiDS Legacy posteriors are mutually incompatible and do not overlap in the EFC-predicted quadrant under identical locked (a_t, δa, k_c); EFC fails the cross-pipeline stability requirement.

KC5: VariantH (Σ = 1 − (µ − 1), α=1) is excluded by DES Y6 (and reaffirmed by KiDS Legacy) after full marginalization or shows no improvement over ΛCDM while preferring A_mu ≥ 0; this kills the VariantH one-parameter EFC extension.

KC6: Fast-scan and subsequent full analysis indicate any significant improvement over ΛCDM occurs in the opposite quadrant (A_mu > 0, A_Sigma < 0); this contradicts EFC sign predictions under the locked gate and falsifies the tested phenomenological direction.
